newsitem.title: INDIA: India Boehringer dips after unit closure.
newsitem.headline: India Boehringer dips after unit closure.

text.p: Boehringer Mannheim India shares fell 11.50 rupees or 13.3 percent to 75.0 at the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Thursday after its unit was closed by authorities, dealers said.
On Wednesday, the Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) shut down the firm's plant near Bombay after tablets manufactured there were found to be contaiminated.
The FDA move came after the state government ruled against the company's appeal for a stay on the decision announced by the FDA about two weeks ago.
The Indian firm is a subsidiary of the German multinational.
